contexts.text: And the heavens and the earth were finished. AC 84.
After the devil had ended all the temptation.
To leave off involves the end of the act which precedes, and the beginning of the one that follows, thus what is successive.
To leave off = the effect of it.
To justify = to declare guiltless and to absolve.
Absolving he will not absolve = tolerance even to consummation; for to absolve is to forgive sin, and when it is added he will not absolve, it is to tolerate.
No harm in enumerating sins before a Minister of the Church for the sake of absolution.
And when they have finished the testimony = at the end of the Church; for to finish = to end.
